groups.title: Status and health
groups.description: Is ECCO Intelligence running, is its latest result fresh, and does the watchdog agree?

groups.title: Advice
groups.description: The advice items: what ECCO Intelligence would suggest, and why. Advice only; nothing is applied.

groups.title: Forecasts
groups.description: Predictions for tomorrow: the home's demand, solar generation and the battery level in the morning.

groups.title: Data quality and accuracy
groups.description: How reliable the inputs are and how accurate recent results have been.

groups.title: Controls and alerts
groups.description: The pause switch, the reserve preference and the three alert automations. Geek Mode only shows them.

groups.title: Discovered (not in the catalogue)
groups.description: Entities that follow the ecco_intel_ naming but are not in this catalogue yet. They appear here by themselves.

sources.title: Result is fresh (integration)
sources.description: On while the integration's latest result is still inside its validity time and the system is not paused, stale, starting or failed. Off means there is no current result.

attributes.name: applies_nothing
attributes.description: A safety flag that is always true: ECCO Intelligence applies nothing to the battery, the inverter or any setting. If it were ever false, this output must not be trusted.

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: The version of the data contract this entity follows (ecco-intel-entities/1). Readers only trust a result whose version is the one they expect.

attributes.name: friendly_name
attributes.description: The display name Home Assistant shows for this entity.

attributes.name: generated_at
attributes.description: When the result was computed (UTC). All entities of one publish share this time.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Which part of the Intelligence output this entity is (for example status or charge_target). Readers use it to check they are looking at the right entity.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The mode the integration reports. Always SHADOW: advice only, nothing is applied.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The overall ECCO Intelligence status when this freshness flag was published.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The time until which the latest result counts as fresh. Empty under a paused, stale, starting or failed status.

sources.title: Intelligence status
sources.description: The one word that says whether ECCO Intelligence has advice for you right now: OK, NO_ADVICE, BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, STARTING, PAUSED, STALE or SELF_TEST_FAILED. Its attributes carry the report time, the blocked conditions, the open owner decisions, the input ages and more. Advice only: nothing it says is applied.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The recent accuracy block: mean absolute error, how much of the last 7 days was measured, and the number of measurements. Empty until measured.

attributes.name: accuracy.coverage_7d
attributes.description: The share of the last 7 days that could be measured, between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: accuracy.mae_7d
attributes.description: The mean absolute error of recent results over 7 days, in kWh.

attributes.name: accuracy.n
attributes.description: How many measurements the accuracy block rests on.

attributes.name: applies_nothing
attributes.description: A safety flag that is always true: ECCO Intelligence applies nothing to the battery, the inverter or any setting. If it were ever false, this output must not be trusted.

attributes.name: blockers
attributes.description: The conditions that withhold advice as a whole, not tied to one item (for example an owner decision that is INVALID). Each has a short code and a sentence. An empty list means none.

attributes.name: calibration
attributes.description: Reserved for a future release. Always empty in this one.

attributes.name: config_hash
attributes.description: A fingerprint of the site configuration, used to tell whether it changed. Geek Mode withholds the value: the integration's own diagnostics redact it as a site value.

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: The version of the data contract this entity follows (ecco-intel-entities/1). Readers only trust a result whose version is the one they expect.

attributes.name: data_quality
attributes.description: The data-quality word for this result: OK, DEGRADED, BLOCKED or UNKNOWN.

attributes.name: decisions
attributes.description: The state of each of the nine owner decisions, I-D1 to I-D9.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D1
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D1: Canonical soft planning floor. Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D2
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D2: Inverter physical protection level. Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D3
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D3: Battery capacity authority. Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D4
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D4: Capacity mismatch band. Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D5
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D5: Efficiency basis. Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D6
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D6: Advisory freshness limits. Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D7
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D7: Required signals per advisor (retired). Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D8
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D8: Derived house-load cut-over and pre-fix history. Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: decisions.I-D9
attributes.description: Owner decision I-D9: Clock-change night policy. Its state is OPEN (not decided yet), RECORDED (decided) or INVALID (recorded but not usable). Battery advice that depends on it stays withheld until it is RECORDED.

attributes.name: device_class
attributes.description: Home Assistant's device class. 'enum' tells Home Assistant that the state is one of a fixed list of words.

attributes.name: drift
attributes.description: Reserved for a future release. Always empty in this one.

attributes.name: engine_version
attributes.description: The version of the advice engine inside the integration.

attributes.name: friendly_name
attributes.description: The display name Home Assistant shows for this entity.

attributes.name: generated_at
attributes.description: When the cycle that produced every figure ran (UTC). All entities of one publish share this time.

attributes.name: git_sha
attributes.description: The source-code revision the engine was built from. Geek Mode withholds the value: the integration's own diagnostics redact it as a site value.

attributes.name: input_ages
attributes.description: How old each input to the latest cycle was, against its freshness limit. One row per input with its name, age in seconds, limit in seconds and a status: fresh, stale, unknown or missing.

attributes.name: integration_version
attributes.description: The version of the ECCO Intelligence integration that produced this result.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Always 'status' for this entity.

attributes.name: last_good
attributes.description: Only while paused, stale, starting or failed: the last good figures from before, with the time they were computed. History for reference, never current advice.

attributes.name: last_good.generated_at
attributes.description: When the last good figures were computed (UTC).

attributes.name: last_good.values
attributes.description: The last good figure of each item and forecast that had one, by name.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The mode the integration reports. Always SHADOW: advice only, nothing is applied.

attributes.name: next_run_at
attributes.description: When the integration plans to run its next cycle.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: The complete list of words the state can take.

attributes.name: pause_control
attributes.description: What the integration sees of the pause switch: ON, OFF, or MISSING (the switch does not exist, so Intelligence treats it as not paused).

attributes.name: plan
attributes.description: The plan around the charge target: when to pre-charge by, the PV headroom ceiling and when the reserve would run out. Only while the charge target is OK; empty otherwise.

attributes.name: plan.headroom_ceiling_pct
attributes.description: The highest charge level, in percent, that still leaves room for tomorrow's solar on a cautious forecast. The charge target stays the authority when it is higher.

attributes.name: plan.precharge_by
attributes.description: The time by which charging should start, taken from the older V1 recommendation, or empty.

attributes.name: plan.reserve_runout_at
attributes.description: When, without grid charging, the battery would reach its reserve level before the planning horizon ends, or empty.

attributes.name: provenance_ok
attributes.description: True while every recorded owner decision comes from a source the system accepts (not a test or synthetic source).

attributes.name: reason_codes
attributes.description: Short codes that explain the overall result: why advice is withheld, a missing pause switch, a redacted text.

attributes.name: self_test
attributes.description: The result of the integration's start-up self-test, one entry per check: PASS, or FAIL followed by the reason. Empty when the integration carries no self-test result.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The same word as the state: the overall status (OK, NO_ADVICE, BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, STARTING, PAUSED, STALE or SELF_TEST_FAILED).

attributes.name: tariff
attributes.description: The tariff facts the plan used: how far its prices can be trusted, the charge window and the price range. Prices appear only when the tariff is verified.

attributes.name: tariff.price_range
attributes.description: The lowest and highest unit price in the verified window, in pence per kWh. Empty unless the tariff is verified.

attributes.name: tariff.provenance
attributes.description: Where the tariff's prices come from and how far they can be trusted. Only VERIFIED or VERIFIED_FROM_INTEGRATION allow prices to be shown.

attributes.name: tariff.window
attributes.description: The cheap-rate charge window the plan used (start and end, UTC), or empty.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Until when the whole result may be used. After it, nothing may be shown as current advice. Empty while paused, starting, stale or failed.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: An estimate of the money value of following the advice, with its assumptions and the alternatives it was compared with. Only with a verified tariff and an OK charge target; empty otherwise.

attributes.name: value.assumptions
attributes.description: The assumptions behind the money estimate, in words (for example that VAT and the standing charge are excluded).

attributes.name: value.baselines
attributes.description: The alternatives the saving was compared with (for example always charging to the maximum), each with its own low-to-high range in pounds.

attributes.name: value.range_gbp
attributes.description: The estimated saving as a low-to-high range, in pounds, against the main alternative. Rounded outward, so it never claims more precision than the evidence.

sources.title: Watchdog: recognised, recent result
sources.description: Home Assistant's own dead-man check on the status. On only while a recognised, recent result exists. It keeps working when the integration itself is down, which is why it is the most reliable sign of a silent failure.

attributes.name: friendly_name
attributes.description: The display name Home Assistant shows for this entity.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: The icon Home Assistant shows for this entity.

sources.title: Next charge target
sources.description: The battery level, in percent, that ECCO Intelligence advises charging to by the end of the next cheap-rate window: the reserve plus a margin plus the battery's share of the energy the home is expected to use. The state is empty unless the status is OK and the result is still valid. Advice only.

attributes.name: advice
attributes.description: The working behind the figure. For an OK item: the full breakdown (the sub-rows below). For an item that is not OK: only its status and the codes of what blocks it.

attributes.name: advice.achievable_soc_pct
attributes.description: The level, in percent, the window can reach from the level it starts at. Empty when that level is not known.

attributes.name: advice.binding_constraint
attributes.description: What set or capped the target: RESERVE, DESIRED_MORNING_SOC, DEMAND, MAX_SOC (even a full battery may not cover the period), CHARGE_WINDOW (the window cannot reach the target) or NO_DEMAND_EVIDENCE.

attributes.name: advice.blocker_codes
attributes.description: Only when the item is not OK: the short codes of the conditions that block it. Absent when the item is OK.

attributes.name: advice.buffer_pct
attributes.description: The safety margin, in percentage points, kept above the reserve.

attributes.name: advice.changed_from_previous
attributes.description: What changed since the previous advice: the change in points and the inputs that drove it. Empty when there is no previous advice.

attributes.name: advice.conservative_fallback
attributes.description: True when the target is the cautious default (charge to the maximum) because overnight demand has not been learned yet.

attributes.name: advice.demand_expected_kwh
attributes.description: The expected (middle) overnight demand, in kWh, for comparison.

attributes.name: advice.demand_planning_kwh
attributes.description: The cautious (planning) overnight demand used, in kWh.

attributes.name: advice.desired_morning_soc_pct
attributes.description: The morning battery level the owner would like, in percent, or empty if none is set.

attributes.name: advice.effective_reserve_pct
attributes.description: The lowest battery level, in percent, this advice allows itself: the highest of the owner's reserve, the technical minimum, a Home Assistant reserve and the raise preference.

attributes.name: advice.end_of_period_floor_pct
attributes.description: The lowest level, in percent, the battery should still have at the end of the period: the higher of the reserve plus margin and the desired morning level.

attributes.name: advice.grid_charge_kwh
attributes.description: The energy, in kWh, to take from the grid to reach the target. Empty when the starting level is not known.

attributes.name: advice.inputs_used
attributes.description: The rounded inputs of this calculation (floor, demand, solar credit, capacity, efficiency). They are compared with the previous advice to say what moved the target.

attributes.name: advice.need_soc_pct
attributes.description: The net need expressed as battery percentage points, allowing for charging losses and capacity.

attributes.name: advice.net_need_kwh
attributes.description: The energy, in kWh, the battery has to supply after the solar credit.

attributes.name: advice.pv_credit_used_kwh
attributes.description: Solar energy, in kWh, counted against the demand. 0 unless a solar credit was vouched for with at least MEDIUM confidence.

attributes.name: advice.raw_target_soc_pct
attributes.description: The target before rounding up to the next step and capping at the maximum, in percent. Empty when there was not enough evidence.

attributes.name: advice.reserve
attributes.description: How the effective battery reserve was worked out: the owner's reserve, the technical minimum, any Home Assistant reserve and any raise preference, and which of them set the level.

attributes.name: advice.shortfall_soc_pct
attributes.description: How many percentage points the need exceeds the maximum charge level. 0 means the target covers it.

attributes.name: advice.status
attributes.description: Only when the item is not OK: the item's status (BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, NO_ADVICE or WITHHELD). Absent when the item is OK, because the full advice is given instead.

attributes.name: advice.target_soc_pct
attributes.description: The advised charge target, in percent: charge to this level by the end of the window. Advice only.

attributes.name: advice.window
attributes.description: The charge window the target is for: its start and end times.

attributes.name: advice.window_start_soc_pct
attributes.description: The battery level, in percent, the window starts from. Empty when not known.

attributes.name: advice.window_start_soc_source
attributes.description: Where the starting level came from: the current level (window open) or a predicted one.

attributes.name: applies_nothing
attributes.description: A safety flag that is always true: ECCO Intelligence applies nothing to the battery, the inverter or any setting. If it were ever false, this output must not be trusted.

attributes.name: blockers
attributes.description: The conditions that currently withhold this result. Each has a short code and a sentence saying what is missing. An empty list means nothing blocks it.

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: How much to trust the figure: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW or INSUFFICIENT. Empty when there is no figure.

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: The version of the data contract this entity follows (ecco-intel-entities/1). Readers only trust a result whose version is the one they expect.

attributes.name: engine_comparison
attributes.description: A comparison with the older V1 engine's answer. Only the charge target carries it, and only while it is OK; empty otherwise.

attributes.name: engine_comparison.authority
attributes.description: Which engine's answer is the authority: the V1.1 charge target.

attributes.name: engine_comparison.basis
attributes.description: How the two engines differ: an hourly simulation (V1) versus a closed-form budget (V1.1).

attributes.name: engine_comparison.difference_pct
attributes.description: V1's target minus the V1.1 target, in percentage points.

attributes.name: engine_comparison.v11_target_soc_pct
attributes.description: The V1.1 charge target, in percent (the same as the advice).

attributes.name: engine_comparison.v1_feasible_on_pessimistic_path
attributes.description: Whether V1's target stays feasible on its pessimistic forecast path.

attributes.name: engine_comparison.v1_target_soc_pct
attributes.description: The older V1 engine's target, in percent.

sources.title: Dump to Grid estimate
sources.description: The energy, in kWh, that a reserve-aware Dump to Grid would export now, stopping at a level that keeps the reserve and what the home needs until the next refill. Advice only: the Dump to Grid feature does not read it.

attributes.name: advice
attributes.description: The working behind the figure. For an OK item: the full breakdown (the sub-rows below). For an item that is not OK: only its status and the codes of what blocks it.

attributes.name: advice.blocker_codes
attributes.description: Only when the item is not OK: the short codes of the conditions that block it. Absent when the item is OK.

attributes.name: advice.desired_min_pct
attributes.description: The lowest battery level, in percent, this advice plans to leave: the effective reserve plus the safety margin.

attributes.name: advice.dump_advisable
attributes.description: Whether a reserve-aware Dump to Grid would be advisable now.

attributes.name: advice.effective_reserve_pct
attributes.description: The lowest battery level, in percent, this advice allows itself: the highest of the owner's reserve, the technical minimum, a Home Assistant reserve and the raise preference.

attributes.name: advice.export_kw_avg
attributes.description: The average export power, in kW, that exporting that energy over the available time would need.

attributes.name: advice.export_kwh
attributes.description: The energy, in kWh, that could be exported (rounded down, within the power limits when they are known).

attributes.name: advice.export_limited_by
attributes.description: What limits the export amount: STOP_LEVEL (the energy above the stop level) or POWER_LIMIT, or empty when not stated.

attributes.name: advice.feature_stop_bounds_pct
attributes.description: The lowest and highest stop level, in percent, that the Dump to Grid feature accepts.

attributes.name: advice.keep_soc_pct
attributes.description: That kept-back energy expressed as battery percentage points.

attributes.name: advice.keep_until_refill_kwh
attributes.description: The energy, in kWh, kept back for the home until the next refill.

attributes.name: advice.raw_stop_soc_pct
attributes.description: The stop level before rounding up to a whole percent and keeping inside the feature's range.

attributes.name: advice.refill_at
attributes.description: When the battery can next be refilled (the end of the next cheap-rate window).

attributes.name: advice.reserve
attributes.description: How the effective battery reserve was worked out: the owner's reserve, the technical minimum, any Home Assistant reserve and any raise preference, and which of them set the level.

attributes.name: advice.soc_pct
attributes.description: The battery level, in percent, when the advice was computed.

attributes.name: advice.status
attributes.description: Only when the item is not OK: the item's status (BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, NO_ADVICE or WITHHELD). Absent when the item is OK, because the full advice is given instead.

attributes.name: advice.stop_set_by
attributes.description: What set the stop level: RESERVE_AND_DEMAND (the reserve, margin and later needs), FEATURE_MINIMUM (the feature's own lowest stop level) or ABOVE_FEATURE_RANGE (nothing to advise).

attributes.name: advice.stop_soc_pct
attributes.description: The stop level, in percent, such a Dump to Grid would use. Empty when it is above the feature's maximum, so there is nothing to advise.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence reports that it may apply changes. This release is advice only and must never do that.
alerts.action: Do not rely on its output. Disable the ECCO Intelligence integration and report this.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence does not state that it applies nothing. This release is advice only and must always say so.
alerts.action: Do not rely on its output. Disable the ECCO Intelligence integration and report this.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence publishes a data contract this view does not know, so its figures cannot be trusted here.
alerts.action: Do not rely on the figures shown. Update this dashboard and the ECCO Intelligence package to the same release as the integration, then reload.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence reports a mode other than SHADOW. This release is advice only and must never run in any other mode.
alerts.action: Do not rely on its output. Disable the ECCO Intelligence integration and report this.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence failed its start-up self-test and is publishing no advice.
alerts.action: Open the status details to see which checks failed, fix them, then reload the ECCO Intelligence integration in Home Assistant.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence is not publishing: its status is unavailable or missing.
alerts.action: Check that the ECCO Intelligence integration is installed and loaded in Settings, Devices and services. Nothing on your system was changed.

alerts.text: Data quality is blocked: ECCO Intelligence cannot rely on its inputs, so advice is withheld.
alerts.action: Open the input ages and the blocked conditions to see which input is missing or too old.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence cannot see its pause switch, so it cannot be paused from Home Assistant.
alerts.action: Install the ECCO Intelligence package that defines the pause switch, then reload.

alerts.text: The pause switch is missing or unavailable, so ECCO Intelligence cannot be paused.
alerts.action: Install or reload the ECCO Intelligence package that defines the pause switch.

alerts.text: The last ECCO Intelligence result is out of date, so no advice figures are shown.
alerts.action: Check that the ECCO Intelligence integration is loaded (Settings, Devices and services). Nothing on your system was changed.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence published a status word this view does not recognise.
alerts.action: Do not rely on the figures shown. Check that this dashboard and the integration are the same release.

alerts.text: The watchdog does not see a fresh, recognised ECCO Intelligence result.
alerts.action: Check that the integration is running. A Home Assistant notification follows if the watchdog stays off for 30 minutes.

alerts.text: The watchdog is missing or unavailable, so a silent failure of ECCO Intelligence would not be noticed.
alerts.action: Install or reload the ECCO Intelligence package that defines the watchdog.

alerts.text: Data quality is degraded: some inputs are old or missing, so advice has lower confidence.
alerts.action: Open the input ages to see which input needs attention.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence is withholding advice because a required input or an owner decision is not in place.
alerts.action: Open the blocked conditions to see exactly what is missing. Nothing is applied either way.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence does not have enough recent data to give advice yet.
alerts.action: No action is needed; figures appear once enough history has been collected.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence is paused. It is producing no advice.
alerts.action: Turn the Pause switch off when you want advice again. Nothing else is affected.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence is starting up. The first result normally arrives within a few minutes.
alerts.action: Wait a few minutes. If it stays like this, check that the integration is loaded.

alerts.text: ECCO Intelligence has not published a result yet.
alerts.action: Wait a few minutes after Home Assistant starts. If it stays like this, check that the integration is loaded.

exceptions.what: Entity-registry facts: unique id, disabled or hidden flags, recorder exclusions
exceptions.note: The registry is read through a websocket call. By contract the unique id equals the entity's object id.

exceptions.what: Contract field 'scorecard_report' (an internal result of one cycle)
exceptions.note: The scorecard report of one cycle is kept in the integration's own database, never published, and never contains a recommendation. Showing it would need a new read-only diagnostic entity.

exceptions.what: Home Assistant and integration log lines
exceptions.note: Logs are files, not states. Showing them would need a read-only log endpoint and a redaction pass: a separate security decision, not a card feature.

exceptions.what: The persistent notifications the three alert automations create
exceptions.note: A notification is not a state. Their texts are fixed (see the three automations); the alert strip shows the same conditions from the entity states.

exceptions.what: History and long-term statistics of these entities (the Home Assistant recorder)
exceptions.note: History is not a state: it is read with a history request, and Geek Mode makes no request of any kind. The integration also keeps the advice, input ages and self-test attributes and the timestamps out of the recorder, so history would lack them. Showing history would need an explicit decision to allow one read-only history query.
The integration's own diagnostics download redacts this site value; Geek Mode never shows it.
The integration's own diagnostics download redacts this site value; Geek Mode never shows it.

exceptions.what: The scorecard database of past cycles (scorecard.sqlite3 in the integration's state folder)
exceptions.note: A file, not a state. It holds accuracy bookkeeping only (never a recommendation). Showing it would need a new read-only diagnostic entity.

exceptions.what: The owner's site file (site.local.json) that maps the cycle's inputs to the owner's own entities
exceptions.note: It is site data (entity ids, tariffs, device names) and is never shown. The integration's own diagnostics redact the entity map for the same reason.

exceptions.what: The 28 site readings one cycle consumes (battery state, capacity, tariff tables, forecasts, ...)
exceptions.note: They are the owner's other entities, read through the site file's mapping. Intelligence publishes only their names and ages (the status attribute input_ages), never their values. Their values belong to those entities' own tabs.

exceptions.what: The context of each state change (which user, automation or integration caused it)
exceptions.note: A context can hold user ids. The Intelligence entities are written only by the integration, so it would add nothing.
